s: On which date was the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan launched by PM Modi?
x: PM Gati Shakti was launched on 13 October 2021 and completed five years in October 2026; 17 September 2022 is the launch date of the National Logistics Policy.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan connects 58 Central Ministries and all 36 States/UTs.
2. The nodal body for PM Gati Shakti is DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
3. The Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) will appraise central infrastructure projects of ₹1,000 crore or more.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. ITLA will appraise central infrastructure projects of ₹500 crore or more, not ₹1,000 crore.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the seven sectors covered by the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan?
x: The seven sectors are Railways, Roads, Ports, Waterways, Airports, Mass Transport and Logistics Infrastructure; Telecommunications is not among them.

s: Which became India's first Union Territory with 100% literacy under ULLAS in October 2026?
x: Lakshadweep was declared the first UT with 100% literacy under ULLAS on 11 October 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Lakshadweep was declared fully literate under ULLAS on 11 October 2026 by Administrator Praful Patel.
2. All 1,311 identified illiterate adults of Lakshadweep passed the FLNAT.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. The number of identified illiterate adults who passed FLNAT was 1,113, not 1,311.

s: Under the VB-G RAM G Act 2025, the number of permissible rural works was raised from 266 to how many in October 2026?
x: The Ministry of Rural Development notified an increase in works from 266 to 375 under four pillars, a 41% increase.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The increase in works under the VB-G RAM G Act 2025 was notified by the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. Works under the VB-G RAM G Act are planned through Gram Sabha-approved Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPP).
3. Article 243G of the Constitution defines the Gram Sabha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Gram Sabha is defined in Article 243(b); Article 243G deals with devolution of powers.

s: Under the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (PMSSY), which of the following pairs (old name – new name) is INCORRECTLY matched?
x: IGNDPS has been renamed PM Divyangjan Pension Yojana; PM Parivar Labh Yojana is the new name of NFBS.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) was launched on 15 August 1995.
2. NSAP is a contributory scheme jointly funded by the Centre and the States.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. NSAP is fully centrally funded and non-contributory.

s: The ₹53,428 crore Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana approved by the Cabinet on 21 October 2026 covers which period?
x: The Cabinet renamed NSAP as PMSSY and continued it from 2026-27 to 2030-31.

s: Where was the Shilp Samagam Mela-2026 held from 21 to 28 October 2026?
x: The 21-28 October 2026 edition was held in Guwahati, Assam; it followed the Mysuru edition that ended on 19 October 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Shilp Samagam Mela?
o: It is organised by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
It gives market access to SC, OBC, Safai Mitra and DNT artisans.
Over 1,000 artisans took part in its first 14 editions.
x: The Shilp Samagam Mela was launched in 2022, not 2019; the other statements are correct.

s: Which institute launched India's first "Goodness" academic credit course in October 2026?
x: IIT Hyderabad launched "Goodness: Character, Responsibility and Human Flourishing" (LA2270) as a one-credit elective.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The "Goodness" course (LA2270) of IIT Hyderabad is a one-credit elective for all UG students with no prerequisites.
2. IIT Hyderabad was established in 2008 at Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana.
3. IITs are Institutes of National Importance under the Institutes of Technology Act, 1956.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. IITs are Institutes of National Importance under the Institutes of Technology Act, 1961.

s: On which date was the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme launched?
x: UDAN was launched on 21 October 2016 and completed 10 years in October 2026; the first UDAN flight (Shimla-Delhi) was on 27 April 2017.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The first UDAN flight was Shimla-Delhi on 27 April 2017.
2. Modified UDAN was approved by the Cabinet on 25 March 2026 with ₹28,840 crore for 10 years.
3. Operational airports in India rose from 74 in 2014 to 166 in 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three statements are correct.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UDAN scheme?
o: It is run by the Ministry of Civil Aviation through AAI.
It has covered 687 routes and 95 airports, heliports and water aerodromes.
Modified UDAN was launched by the PM at Jaipur Airport on 4 July 2026.
x: Modified UDAN was launched by the PM at Jodhpur Airport, not Jaipur, on 4 July 2026.

s: Which Ministry issued the guidelines for the ₹84,084 crore Samudra Manthan Scheme in October 2026?
o: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
x: The Samudra Manthan Scheme for deepwater and ultra-deepwater oil and gas exploration is under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under the Samudra Manthan Scheme, deepwater means a depth of over 500 m.
2. The government funds up to 50% of the drilling cost, with a maximum of ₹675 crore per well.
3. Only PSUs and PSU-led consortia are eligible under the scheme.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Deepwater means over 400 m; ultra-deepwater means over 1,500 m.

s: How many wells will the Samudra Manthan Scheme support?
x: The scheme supports 56 exploratory and 4 stratigraphic wells, 60 wells in all, with total support up to ₹43,200 crore.

s: Who declared Ladakh India's first 100% organic Union Territory on 25 October 2026?
x: Lt Governor V. K. Saxena declared Ladakh India's first 100% organic UT on 25 October 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Sikkim became India's first fully organic State in 2016.
2. Ladakh became a Union Territory on 31 October 2019 under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019.
3. The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) was launched in 2018.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. PKVY was launched in 2015.

s:
Assertion (A): Ladakh was declared India's first 100% organic Union Territory in October 2026.
Reason (R): The sale and use of chemical fertilisers was banned in Ladakh from July 2026.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: Both are true, and the ban on chemical fertilisers from July 2026, with organic fertilisers given before sowing, made Ladakh fully organic.

s: From which city will Kerala's proposed cooperative airline "Co-Keralam" start operations?
x: Co-Keralam is to start from Kochi with two leased 72-seat aircraft.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The cooperative airline "Co-Keralam" was announced by Kerala CM V. D. Satheesan.
2. Co-Keralam will start with two leased 72-seat aircraft.
3. The Union Ministry of Cooperation was established on 6 July 2020.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Ministry of Cooperation was established on 6 July 2021.

s: Which institute introduced India's first thesis-free PhD in October 2026?
x: IIT Ropar introduced a PhD that can be earned through products, patents, technology transfer or startups.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the thesis-free PhD of IIT Ropar?
o: A product earning ₹10 lakh revenue may qualify for the PhD.
It aims to promote applied research.
IIT Ropar is located at Kamand, Himachal Pradesh.
x: IIT Ropar is at Rupnagar, Punjab; Kamand in Himachal Pradesh is the site of IIT Mandi.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Component II of the RELIEF Scheme has been extended to 31 March 2028.
2. The RELIEF Scheme is implemented by ECGC Limited through a digital portal.
3. The RELIEF Scheme was formulated by the Department of Commerce.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Component II was extended to 31 March 2027, not 2028.

s: ECGC Limited, which implements the RELIEF Scheme for exporters, was established in which year?
x: ECGC Limited was established in 1957 and has its headquarters in Mumbai.

s: Which IIT launched the "Science on Wheels" programme for rural school students in Himachal Pradesh on 17 October 2026?
x: IIT Mandi launched Science on Wheels with Plaksha University and IDYM Foundation, supported by DST.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IIT Mandi was established in 2009 at Kamand.
2. The Department of Science and Technology (DST), which supports "Science on Wheels", was established in 1971.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both statements are correct.

s: What is the outlay of the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme approved by the Cabinet on 29 October 2026?
x: The scheme has an outlay of ₹1,856.67 crore for 2026 to FY 2033-34.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme will run from 2026 to FY 2033-34.
2. Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones (SGMZs) will use BHAVYA Scheme infrastructure and NICDC industrial parks.
3. The scheme is aligned with the Khelo Bharat Niti 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three statements are correct.

s: Which of the following pairs (scheme – outlay) is correctly matched?
o: Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme – ₹84,084 crore
Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana – ₹1,856.67 crore
x: CMPS has ₹10,000 crore; Samudra Manthan has ₹84,084 crore, the Khelo India scheme ₹1,856.67 crore and PMSSY ₹53,428 crore.

s: Which is the nodal Ministry for the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PM VGSY)?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
x: PM VGSY, approved on 29 October 2026, has the Ministry of Panchayati Raj as its nodal Ministry.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. PM VGSY has a total outlay of ₹7,395.55 crore, of which the Centre's share is ₹4,869.48 crore.
2. PM VGSY runs from 2026-27 to 2030-31, the period of the 16th Finance Commission.
3. PM VGSY will create permanent posts in Panchayats.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. PM VGSY creates no permanent jobs, though contractual staff are allowed.

s: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, on Panchayati Raj came into force on which date?
x: The 73rd Amendment, 1992 came into force on 24 April 1993, which is why 24 April is National Panchayati Raj Day.

s: Which Ministry is responsible for the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) approved on 29 October 2026?
o: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
x: CMPS is under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS)?
o: It gives Interest Subvention Assistance of 3% a year.
It includes Testing and Certification Assistance of ₹150 crore.
x: CMPS covers both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.

s: The "Punah Bharan" app for groundwater recharge planning was developed by BISAG-N with which body?
x: Punah Bharan was developed by BISAG-N with the National Water Mission, one of the eight NAPCC missions.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The "Punah Bharan" app finds recharge sites within a 5-km radius.
2. The National Water Mission is one of the eight missions under the NAPCC (2008).
3. BISAG-N is under MeitY and has its headquarters at Gandhinagar.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The app finds recharge sites within a 3-km radius.

s: How many farmers received the 24th PM-KISAN instalment on 31 October 2026?
x: The 24th instalment of over ₹18,690 crore went to 9.34 crore farmers.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. PM-KISAN was launched on 24 February 2019 and made effective from 1 December 2018.
2. PM-KISAN is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
3. PM-KISAN gives ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme, not a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.

s:
Arrange in chronological order:
1. Launch of the UDAN scheme
2. Launch of PM-KISAN
3. Launch of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
4. Launch of the National Logistics Policy
x: UDAN was launched on 21 October 2016, PM-KISAN on 24 February 2019, PM Gati Shakti on 13 October 2021 and the National Logistics Policy on 17 September 2022.

s: Where was the ₹325 crore Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre inaugurated by PM Modi on 1 November 2026?
x: The centre was set up by Banas Dairy at Bhildi in Banaskantha, Gujarat; Anand is the headquarters of NDDB.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre was set up by Banas Dairy on 127 acres with NDDB technical guidance.
2. The centre is under the Rashtriya Gokul Mission, which was launched in December 2014.
3. NDDB was established in 1965 with its headquarters at Anand.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three statements are correct.

s: NITI Aayog signed a Statement of Intent on critical minerals with TEXMiN on 4 November 2026. TEXMiN is located at which institute?
x: TEXMiN is the Technology Translation Research Park at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, supported by DST.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. NITI Aayog was established on 1 January 2015 and is chaired by the Prime Minister.
2. IIT (ISM) Dhanbad was set up in 1926 as the Indian School of Mines and got IIT status in 2016.
3. The National Critical Mineral Mission was approved in January 2025 with an expenditure of ₹18,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. NCMM has an expenditure of ₹16,300 crore; ₹18,000 crore is the expected investment.

s: CESL, which signed an MoU with the Ministry of Panchayati Raj for EV infrastructure in Panchayats, is a wholly owned subsidiary of which company?
x: CESL, established in 2020, is a wholly owned subsidiary of EESL, a PSU joint venture under the Ministry of Power.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under the MoPR-CESL MoU, EV charging and battery-swapping facilities will be set up on Panchayat-owned land.
2. The People's Plan Campaign for GPDPs is known as "Sabki Yojana Sabka Vikas".
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both statements are correct.
